question_bank.stem: When the hockey video prompt produced an implausible scene, what procedural step had been skipped?

options.label: A
options.text: Have the model understand the intent, available tools, and Veo constraints before planning the prompt.

options.label: B
options.text: Ask the video tool for more random variations before describing the scene constraints.

options.label: C
options.text: Shorten the prompt to a single visual noun phrase before testing the video engine.

options.label: D
options.text: Replace the story context with model benchmarks before generating the clip.

question_bank.correct_answer: Have the model understand the intent, available tools, and Veo constraints before planning the prompt.
question_bank.explanation: Laurence says he did not go through the steps of understanding intent, understanding the tools and Veo, and making a plan for the prompt.

question_bank.stem: How should an agentic creative workflow reduce costly trial-and-error in video generation?

options.label: A
options.text: Ignore the target engine so the prompt remains general across all tools.

options.label: B
options.text: Generate many videos first and then infer the user's intent afterward.

options.label: C
options.text: Use a shorter prompt so the video model has fewer constraints to satisfy.

options.label: D
options.text: Provide scene intent, story context, tool choice, and constraints before refining the prompt.

question_bank.correct_answer: Provide scene intent, story context, tool choice, and constraints before refining the prompt.
question_bank.explanation: The agentic workflow gives the LLM scene context, story context, explicit video-engine information, and constraints before refining the prompt, saving repeated video-generation attempts.
